subject.title: bundle-mcp: remote streamable-http server connects but tools never materialize for a Pi agent (2026.5.7)

question: Should this issue stay open until current-version proof confirms the authenticated streamable-http Pi-agent path, or should maintainers treat the merged sandbox diagnostic/docs fix as enough once the reporter confirms that configuration path?
rationale: Current source and related issues strongly suggest a policy/sandbox gate or already-improved diagnostic path, but this exact remote streamable-http setup has not been replayed on current main/latest release and the related open PR fixes only an adjacent toolFilter mismatch.

options.title: Request current-version proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a latest-release retry with doctor output, sandbox allowlist state, `mcp doctor --probe`, and `context.compiled` evidence before deciding it is fixed.

options.title: Close after reporter confirms sandbox fix
options.body: If the reporter confirms that adding `bundle-mcp` or `group:plugins` to the sandbox tool allowlist restores the remote tools, close as resolved by the existing diagnostic/docs path.

options.title: Promote a focused reproduction task
options.body: Have a maintainer build a small remote streamable-http fixture with bearer auth and verify whether current main exposes its tools in a Pi turn.

recommendation.title: Request current-version proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a latest-release retry with doctor output, sandbox allowlist state, `mcp doctor --probe`, and `context.compiled` evidence before deciding it is fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the MCP runtime, transport, operability docs, and tool projection paths needed to decide whether current proof is enough.
